in_arabic.name: مقيت
in_arabic.meaning: الله تعالیٰ کی ایک صفت، قوت و توانائی کا تعلق رکھنے والا
in_arabic.long_meaning: مقيت اللہ تعالیٰ کی ایک صفتی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے کہ وہ سب کی قوت و توانائی کا تعلق رکھنے والا ہے، اور وہ سب کو اپنی قدرت و قوت کے تحت رکھتا ہے۔ یہ نام قرآن مجید میں ذکر ہوا ہے، اور اس کا اہمیت اسلامی تقویم میں بہت زیادہ ہے۔

in_urdu.name: مقیّت
in_urdu.meaning: خدا کی ایک صفت، جس کا مطلب ہے طاقت و توانائی کا مالک
in_urdu.long_meaning: مقیّت اللہ تعالیٰ کی ایک صفت ہے جو کہ قدرت و توانائی کی نمائش کرتی ہے، اور یہ نام عربی جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے۔ یہ اسلامی تقویم میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے، خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیا میں مسلم معاشرے میں۔

in_hindi.name: मुक़ीत
in_hindi.meaning: भगवान की एक विशेषता, शक्ति और ऊर्जा का स्वामी
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुक़ीत भगवान की एक विशेषता है जो शक्ति और ऊर्जा को दर्शाती है। यह नाम अरबी मूल से लिया गया है और भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इसका महत्व है। यह नाम ताकत और सशक्तिकरण की भावना को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: مقيت
in_pashto.meaning: د قدرت او انرژۍ لرونکی، د خدای ځانګړتیا
in_pashto.long_meaning: مقيت د خدای ځانګړتیا ده چې د قدرت او انرژۍ د لرونکي په معنا ده. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ارزښتونو سره تړاو لري او د اسلامي پېژندګلې په برخه کې ځانګړی اهمیت لري.

in_english.name: Muqeet
in_english.meaning: One of Allah's attributes, meaning the possessor of power and energy
in_english.long_meaning: Muqeet is one of the attributes of Allah, signifying the possessor of power and energy. Etymologically derived from the Arabic root 'q-w-t', it implies strength, capability, and sustenance. This name is mentioned in the Quran, emphasizing Allah's ability to provide sustenance and maintain all creation. Historically, Muqeet holds significance in Islamic tradition, reflecting the omnipotence and benevolence of Allah. The name Muqeet symbolizes strength, resilience, and divine support.

data.cultural_impact: The name Muqeet carries a strong cultural significance as it relates to the Arabic language's rich legacy of emphasizing knowledge and learning. The Arabic language itself is considered the classic language of Islam and contains a vast wealth of knowledge in religious texts, literature, and scientific discoveries. The name Muqeet can be seen as a reminder of the importance of pursuit of knowledge and education in Islamic culture, as it has been a fundamental aspect of Islamic history and society.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Muqeet holds great significance in the Islamic tradition as it reflects the deeply ingrained spiritual emphasis on the pursuit of knowledge for the sake of Allah (God). In Islamic teachings, knowledge is considered a means to come closer to Allah and gain a greater understanding of His creation and His will. The name Muqeet can be seen as a personal reminder for the individual to continue seeking knowledge and wisdom from Allah and to strive for a deeper connection with the divine. Additionally, the name can be seen as a reminder of the Quranic verse, "Allah enhances in guidance those who believe" (Quran 47:17), which encourages believers to continue seeking guidance and knowledge from Allah.
